main.description: Resolve the caller's Coinbase Smart Wallet-compatible ERC-4337 execution-account address on the etzhayyim private chain (chainId 260425). AuthZ first resolves the caller's accountDid to an ERC725 root DID via `etzhayyimRootIdentityRegistry` when available, then reads `etzhayyimActorRegistry.actorByDid(rootDidHash)` via `https://geth.etzhayyim.com`. Returns `{activated:true, smartAccount}` if the actor has activated their account, or `{activated:false, didHash}` otherwise. Caller must hold a session (passkey-first policy, ADR-0074).

rootDid.description: Canonical ERC725 root DID used for on-chain account lookup; equals accountDid for migrated sessions.

rootIdentity.description: ERC725 root identity contract address when resolved.

didHash.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte keccak256 of the canonical ERC725 root DID string. Legacy did:etzhayyim/did:web values are only accepted as facade lookup inputs and are not hashed directly.

errors.name: ConfigError
errors.description: ETH_PRIVATE_RPC_URL, etzhayyim_ACTOR_REGISTRY_ADDR, or etzhayyim_ROOT_IDENTITY_REGISTRY_ADDR is not configured

errors.name: RootIdentityRequired
errors.description: Caller is still on an unmigrated legacy DID with no ERC725 root facade link

errors.name: RpcError
errors.description: Upstream RPC returned an error or unreachable
